protocol.base: fixed context forest; source station OOF predictions
protocol.nonfinite_policy: fail; no skipped update or upper clipping
protocol.initialization: provided original spatial/GRU/decay; zero scalar head
protocol.spatial_mode: eval throughout; empty edges; frozen input normalization
protocol.source_weights: tail weights normalized to unit sum within each source station
protocol.sampling: uniform source-cell shuffle once per epoch; no station resampling
protocol.normalization: fixed full-source mean weight; never a minibatch weight mean
protocol.penalty_prediction: final nonnegative native concentration at residual scale 1
